mission.title: localai: Native windows version?
mission.description: Native windows version?. Requested by 15+ users.

steps.title: Check current localai deployment
steps.description:
Verify your localai version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n localai -l app.kubernetes.io/name=localai
helm list -n localai 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working localai installation.

steps.title: Review localai configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant localai configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n localai -l app.kubernetes.io/name=localai
kubectl get configmap -n localai -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=localai
```
Helllo, I personally find LocalAI very nice, but wish to compare it's efficiency to llama (and derivatives).
Is a windows version (with cpu only option) gonna be available soon?

steps.title: Apply the fix for Native windows version?
steps.description:
Sadly I don't use windows so I probably will struggle into this to various levels (testing, time dedicated to it, etc. ) but any help from the community into that direction is very much appreciated. This point keeps popping up around from the community - even if WSL and Docker works. maybe  could help here?

See the source issue for community-verified solutions.

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n localai -l app.kubernetes.io/name=localai
kubectl get events -n localai --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Native windows version?" is functioning correctly.
